title: Final 07 Belicosa Materializuje Sie
description: Drugie zwycięstwo Dariusza: olbrzymia Belicosa materializuje się wokół działającego auspexu.

prompts.image: Photorealistic 16:9 low three-quarter rooftop hero frame from the front-left roof corner, preserving the corrected front/back geography and rear-right green access hut. Continue directly from final-04: the exact solid auspex remains unchanged at the operator position while the canonical Belicosa is halfway materialized around it. Preserve the completed defense reference for final scale and placement. The 6 m circular base is mostly solid and visibly heavy; two of exactly four radial outriggers are fully solid and two complete from translucent green-gold angular planes in their exact final locations. Lower breech mechanisms and hydraulic cradle are solid. The single 14 m barrel rises about 58 degrees into the upper-left sky: lower cooling sections are solid while the upper section and rectangular muzzle, unmistakably the highest/front end, still condense from aligned wireframe planes and restrained light particles. The 1.15 m auspex remains fully solid inside the emerging left operator platform; rails and platform floor are partly materialized. Green-gold reflections on wet bitumen, slight roof bowing but no cracks. Exactly one cannon, barrel, muzzle, base, four supports, platform and auspex. No people, K20, ships, firing, projectile, overheat, steam, collapse, horizontal or facade-facing aim, duplicate components, mech, text, UI or watermark.
prompts.animation: One continuous 5-second static low shot. The circular base locks to the roof first, four outriggers extend and brace separately, then the single long barrel and left operator platform condense around the existing auspex from geometric green-gold light. The roof groans under the final weight; no firing yet. Preserve the exact canonical geometry throughout.
